subject: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance
overview: The committee met to review legal counsel feedback and department comments on a proposed wildlife feeding ordinance. Members voted to have the sponsor revise the draft ordinance offline to address definitions, enforcement terms, and feral cat regulations ahead of a follow-up meeting in July.

items.title: Resolution 23-449: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance
items.summary: The committee reviewed legal advice from KP Law and input from the Board of Health regarding enforcement language, definitions for bird feeders and pets, and regulations concerning feral cat trap-and-release practices. A motion passed authorizing Vice President Collins to revise the draft ordinance offline and present an updated version in July.
